title: Capability-level SLO definition
objective: Define availability separately for read access, submission, approval and payment dispatch so a headline figure cannot mask a money-movement outage.

title: Independent multi-vantage availability measurement
objective: Measure availability from outside the production environment and per tenant, and retain raw results for customer verification.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Independent status page with timed notification
objective: Publish component status from infrastructure separate from production and notify subscribers within a defined time of detection.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Zero-downtime deployment and change freeze
objective: Deploy without planned downtime by default, run schema changes online, and freeze non-emergency changes during declared customer peak periods.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Automated service credit calculation
objective: Compute credits from the measurement stream without requiring the customer to claim and prove the outage.
owner: Proposed: Finance Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Subprocessor dependency register with live status
objective: Map capabilities to subprocessors, flow down availability expectations, and surface provider status to customers.
owner: Proposed: Vendor Risk Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Typed degraded modes with fail-closed money movement
objective: Represent each dependency outage as an explicit degraded state in which non-financial functions continue, money movement and authority changes fail closed, and the UI shows uncertain states distinctly.
notes: Forma components exist; the Unbound state machine that drives them does not.
